title: [Lonicera japonica attenuates oxidative stress and improves post-ischemic heart failure in mice via the STAT3/PGC-1alpha axis].
authors: Li, Miao; Yu, Guiying; Wang, Jincheng; Xie, Kang; Ouyang, Yulin; Wang, Neng; Wen, Ruijia; Wang, Wei; Li, Chun
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金银花提取物通过STAT3/PGC-1alpha轴改善心衰，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the mechanism by which freeze-dried water extract of Lonicera japonica alleviates oxidative stress and improves post-ischemic heart failure in mice. METHODS: Bioinformatics analyses were carried out to identify the active constituents in Lonicera japonica, their target genes, and their enrichment pathways. Mouse models of ischemic heart failure established by left anterior descending (LAD) artery ligation were treated with different doses of freeze-dried water extract of Lonicera japonica, and the changes in cardiac function, myocardial pathology and expressions of the STAT3/PGC-1alpha axis were examined. In cultured H9C2 cells with oxygen-glucose deprivation (OGD), the effects of Lonicera japonica extract on cell viability, reactive oxygen species (ROS) production and apoptosis were evaluated, and its regulatory effects on STAT3 and PGC-1alpha expression were assessed using Western blotting and immunofluorescence staining; mass spectrometry was employed to analyze the tissue-penetrating components of Lonicera japonica extract, and the binding capacities of its major constituents to STAT3 and PGC-1alpha were simulated with molecular docking studies. RESULTS: In mice with ischemic heart failure, treatment with Lonicera japonica extract significantly improved the cardiac function and alleviated myocardial hypertrophy, inflammatory responses and collagen deposition. The treatment also restored cell viability of H9C2 cells with OGD and reduced cellular ROS production and cell apoptosis. Lonicera japonica extract significantly inhibited STAT3 activation and upregulated PGC-1alpha expression in H9C2 cells with OGD, and this effect was effectively attenuated by application of the STAT3 agonist Colivelin. Molecular docking results suggested that among the components of Lonicera japonica extract capable of entering the myocardial tissues, lonicerin, chlorogenic acid and 1,5-dicaffeoylquinic acid had strong binding affinity with STAT3 and PGC-1alpha. CONCLUSIONS: Lonicera japonica extract alleviates myocardial oxidative stress and improves heart failure in mice via the STAT3/PGC-1alpha axis, suggesting the value of Lonicera japonica in the treatment of heart failure.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨金银花冻干水提物减轻小鼠缺血后心力衰竭氧化应激并改善心功能的机制。方法：采用生物信息学分析鉴定金银花中的活性成分、其靶基因及富集通路。通过左前降支（LAD）动脉结扎建立小鼠缺血性心力衰竭模型，给予不同剂量的金银花冻干水提物处理，检测心功能、心肌病理变化及STAT3/PGC-1α轴表达的改变。在培养的H9C2细胞中，通过氧糖剥夺（OGD）模型评估金银花提取物对细胞活力、活性氧（ROS）产生和凋亡的影响，并利用Western blotting和免疫荧光染色评估其对STAT3和PGC-1α表达的调控作用；采用质谱分析金银花提取物的组织穿透成分，并通过分子对接模拟其主要成分与STAT3和PGC-1α的结合能力。结果：在缺血性心力衰竭小鼠中，金银花提取物处理显著改善了心功能，减轻了心肌肥大、炎症反应和胶原沉积。该处理还恢复了OGD条件下H9C2细胞的活力，并减少了细胞ROS产生和凋亡。金银花提取物显著抑制了OGD条件下H9C2细胞中STAT3的激活，并上调了PGC-1α的表达，而应用STAT3激动剂Colivelin可有效减弱这一效应。分子对接结果表明，在能够进入心肌组织的金银花提取物成分中，忍冬苷、绿原酸和1,5-二咖啡酰奎宁酸与STAT3和PGC-1α具有强结合亲和力。结论：金银花提取物通过STAT3/PGC-1α轴减轻心肌氧化应激并改善小鼠心力衰竭，提示金银花在心力衰竭治疗中具有潜在价值。
